claims.statement: CER is the minimum insertion, deletion and substitution count divided by reference characters. Raw scoring retains whitespace and punctuation. claims.scope: Project-specific Unicode codepoint CER, not a byte/token rate or a recording failure count. HF default transforms are not used. NFKC can change fullwidth punctuation; the resulting punctuation remains. A correct transcript can still receive an incorrect chat response.
